ActorTalk: When it comes to the coolest senior, it's got to be 【kuroname】, right!
...In my opinion, that would be Senior Vanessa. If it hadn't been for her, the darkness surrounding F.O.S. wouldn't have been dispelled so quickly.
But wasn't 【kuroname】 the protagonist of that incident?
Sure, but that's not something that can be solved by a single, lone hero.
My brother was also a member of Scepter House at that time, and he once told me about what happened that night.

At that time, the elite members in Scepter House planned to let the Night continue for their own gain... And just when everyone thought things would descend into chaos and proceed exactly as those elites had anticipated...
Senior Vanessa stepped forward and just locked them up.
I was never one of you.
Those were her words back then... Ever since I heard that story, I've been firmly on Team Vanessa.
That's pretty cool, I'll admit... but I'm still voting for 【kuroname】.
